rules.condition: When exporting the resource publication year; do not infer a month or day.
rules.target_path: described resource -> dcterms:issued -> year-precision literal
rules.notes: Keep year precision. Publication and public availability are distinct events; choose dcterms:available instead if that is what the source year establishes.

rules.condition: Only on the entity identified by the containing DataCite group.
rules.source_path: identifier-bearing subelement in its enclosing agent, award, related item, license, or subject
rules.target_path: identified entity -> dcterms:identifier -> identifier literal
rules.notes: Attach identifiers to their own entity rather than the main resource. Preserve scheme and lexical value separately; bare identifiers are not interchangeable with entity IRIs.

rules.condition: Always retain the scheme when exporting an identifier; normalization requires a scheme-specific rule.
rules.source_path: identifier type/scheme qualifier and corresponding identifier value
rules.target_path: identifier representation plus retained scheme metadata
rules.notes: These qualifiers identify an identifier scheme; they are not themselves identifiers of the resource. DCTERMS/DCAT has no universal identifier-scheme field; retain an extension or source record.

rules.condition: When constructing or identifying an agent from creator, contributor, publisher, or funding metadata.
rules.source_path: agent subelements within their original DataCite group
rules.target_path: agent node and retained name/affiliation metadata
rules.notes: DCTERMS/DCAT does not supply all name and affiliation fields. Preserve names, name language, agent kind, and affiliations with an appropriate extension; do not identify an agent by its name alone.

rules.condition: Only with a containing name-bearing agent; the qualifier is not a statement about the main resource.
rules.target_path: agent node type or retained kind qualifier
rules.notes: Personal and Organizational distinguish the named agent. Preserve this kind using an agent vocabulary; do not assert that the resource itself is a person or organization.

rules.condition: Select from descriptionType while retaining the associated text and language.
rules.target_path: resource -> dcterms:abstract, dcterms:tableOfContents, or dcterms:description -> text
rules.notes: Abstract uses dcterms:abstract, TableOfContents uses dcterms:tableOfContents, and other types can use dcterms:description with the original type retained. Methods are not dcterms:instructionalMethod.

rules.condition: Only for the title text in the same DataCite title element.
rules.source_path: title/@titleType with title value and xml:lang
rules.target_path: resource -> dcterms:title or dcterms:alternative -> language-tagged title
rules.notes: AlternativeTitle can use dcterms:alternative; translated titles require their language. Subtitle and Other must retain their qualifier because DCTERMS does not distinguish all title kinds.

rules.condition: When the related identifier and relationType refer to the same related resource.
rules.source_path: relatedIdentifier or relatedItem group, including identifier scheme and relationType
rules.target_path: resource -> selected relationship -> identified related resource
rules.notes: Resolve the related resource identifier with its scheme and select a relationship using relationType. A generic dcterms:relation fallback loses the qualifier unless the original type and relationTypeInformation are retained.

rules.condition: relatedMetadataScheme/schemeURI/schemeType describe metadata for HasMetadata/IsMetadataFor; schemeURI in other contexts describes the enclosing identifier or subject scheme.
rules.source_path: relatedIdentifier or relatedItemIdentifier metadata-scheme attributes; other schemeURI occurrences remain contextual
rules.target_path: metadata resource and retained scheme reference; do not claim dcterms:conformsTo without conformance evidence
rules.notes: A scheme name or URI alone does not establish resource conformance. Preserve the scheme reference with the metadata/identifier/subject context in which it occurs.

rules.condition: When a subject has a controlled-vocabulary URI or classification scheme.
rules.target_path: resource topic relation -> subject concept; concept retains its scheme and notation
rules.notes: Preserve subject identity and classification scheme. A subject URI describes the topic; it is not the identifier of the main resource.

rules.condition: When bibliographic details describe the related item and its relationship to the resource.
rules.target_path: related item and containing citation metadata
rules.notes: Keep edition, volume, issue, page bounds, and article/report/other numbers in their source context. DCTERMS/DCAT lacks dedicated fields for all of these; use an extension or preserve the source group.

rules.condition: When representing the funding supporting the described resource.
rules.target_path: resource, funding entity, and award nodes with preserved links and award details
rules.notes: DCTERMS/DCAT has no complete funding-reference model. Preserve the funder and award as distinct entities, their identifiers, award title, and award page; an award page is not a resource landing page.

rules.condition: Preserve the qualifier and additional information alongside the same date value.
rules.target_path: selected date predicate plus retained date annotation
rules.notes: A date qualifier chooses how a date is interpreted; it is not a date value or equivalent date predicate. Keep dateInformation and ranges intact.

rules.condition: dateType is Accepted on the date being converted.
rules.target_path: resource -> dcterms:dateAccepted -> date/period value
rules.notes: Select dcterms:dateAccepted only for this qualified date. Preserve original precision and ranges; Coverage needs a temporal-coverage representation, not a publication date.

rules.notes: Keep A as the described resource and B as the related resource. Select dcterms:references with this direction; preserve the more specific DataCite relation qualifier when the target is broader.

rules.notes: Contributor role values are not property equivalents. Preserve the role on the contribution/attribution, not on the main resource; RightsHolder may additionally justify dcterms:rightsHolder. DCAT hadRole belongs on a qualified attribution or relationship node.

rules.notes: The AlternateIdentifier group is a DataCite metadata structure; preserve its values and qualifiers on the correct target node. Its presence does not itself establish a target resource class.

rules.condition: When coordinates and/or a place description belong to the same geoLocation.
rules.target_path: resource -> dcterms:spatial -> location, with geometry/name retained
rules.notes: Construct the location from the full geometry and preserve coordinate order and bounds. DCTERMS spatial alone does not encode polygon vertices or individual coordinates.

rules.condition: When preserving a version number without an identified related version.
rules.target_path: resource version indicator in extension or retained source metadata
rules.notes: A version number is not a related resource. Do not turn its literal value directly into dcterms:hasVersion or dcterms:isVersionOf.
